reliability_note: This is the classic Japanese small-host failure mode: the marketing page stays up and the actual service is down. Every functional URL 503'd while the root page served fine, which is exactly the 'never trust HTTP 200' trap in reverse — here the 200 was the brochure and the 503 was the service.
